title: 第17章 赵管事的刁难第18章 阿玳的第一炉丹
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
＞地脉之龙的咆哮在识海翻腾，林墨单膝跪地，七窍渗出细密血丝。
＞巨石深处，暗金锁链寸寸崩裂！
＞当第一缕龙脉灵气冲破禁锢，顺着猫爪涌入四肢百骸——
＞废丹峰上，枯木逢春。
---
林墨猛地睁开眼！
眼前不再是翻腾的岩浆与咆哮的龙影，而是废丹峰背阴面冰冷粗糙的黑褐色巨石。
掌心传来的不再是毁天灭地的脉动冲击，而是岩石死寂的冰凉。
冷汗浸透了他的后背，心脏在胸腔里狂跳，如同擂鼓，震得他耳膜嗡嗡作响。
识海中残留的剧痛让他太阳穴突突直跳，仿佛被无数根针扎过。
他大口喘息着，空气里弥漫的尘土和岩石腐朽气息，此刻竟显得如此清新。
他下意识地抬手抹了一把脸，指尖触到一片粘腻——是鼻血！
再摸向耳朵和眼角，同样残留着干涸的血迹。
刚才那短短一瞬的感知接触，几乎抽空了他的精神，更对身体造成了不小的冲击。
“呼…呼……”
林墨撑着膝盖，艰难地站起身。
双腿还有些发软，但那股源自地底深处、被重重锁链禁锢的浩瀚脉动感，已深深烙印在他的灵魂深处。
那不是错觉！
废丹峰之下，真的镇压着一条……或者说，一股被强行锁住的、庞大无比的地脉灵气洪流！
那龙形虚影，那暗金锁链，那沉滞千年的悲怆与愤怒……

“猫仙遗迹……地脉核心……”
林墨喃喃自语，看向那块巨大黑石的眼神充满了前所未有的凝重与炽热。
这哪里是什么废峰？这分明是一座被封印的宝山！
御兽宗的人，或者说百年前布下这封印的人，真是暴殄天物！
他尝试再次将猫爪贴上巨石，小心翼翼地调动一丝微弱的灵力。
这一次，他不再强行“梳理”
或深入感知，而是如同最轻柔的羽毛拂过水面。
巨石内部，那股狂暴的脉动似乎平息了许多，但那种被禁锢的沉重感依旧清晰。
他能隐约“听”
到一种低沉的、仿佛来自大地深处的“呜咽”
，带着不甘与渴望。
“现在还不是时候。”
林墨收回手，眼神恢复了清明。
以他现在的实力，贸然触碰这股力量无异于找死。
当务之急，是积蓄力量，提升自己，提升猫群！
无论是应对赵管事、王莽的麻烦，还是未来解开这地脉封印，都需要更强的资本。
他最后深深看了一眼那块仿佛镇压着整个废丹峰气运的巨石，转身，步伐虽然还有些虚浮，但眼神却异常坚定地朝山腰灵田走去。
……
几日后。
清晨的雾气尚未完全散去，林墨便独自下了废丹峰，朝着御兽宗庶务堂的方向走去。

他需要领取这个月杂役份例里那点可怜的口粮和物资——这是维持他自身和猫群基本生存的保障。
content_en:
>The roar of the dragon of earth's veins roiled the sea of ​​consciousness. Lin Mo knelt down on one knee, and fine blood oozed from his seven orifices.
>Deep in the boulder, the dark gold chain cracked inch by inch!
>When the first ray of dragon vein spiritual energy breaks through the confinement and flows into the limbs and bones along the cat's claws——
>On the Feidan Peak, spring comes with dead trees.
---
Lin Mo opened his eyes suddenly!
What he saw in front of him was no longer the churning magma and the roaring dragon shadow, but the cold and rough dark brown boulder on the back side of the Waste Pill Peak.
What came from the palm was no longer the pulsating impact that destroyed the world, but the dead coldness of the rock.
Cold sweat soaked his back, and his heart beat wildly in his chest, like a drum, making his eardrums buzz.
The severe pain remaining in the sea of ​​consciousness made his temples throb, as if he had been pricked by countless needles.
He gasped for breath, and the smell of dust and decaying rocks in the air seemed so fresh at this moment.
He subconsciously raised his hand to wipe his face, and his fingertips touched a sticky patch - it was a nosebleed!
Then he touched his ears and the corners of his eyes, and there was still dried blood.
The short moment of sensory contact just now almost drained his energy and caused a considerable impact on his body.
"Huh...huh..."
Lin Mo stood up with difficulty, holding his knees.
His legs were still a little weak, but the vast pulsating feeling that originated from deep underground and was imprisoned by heavy chains had been deeply imprinted in the depths of his soul.
That's not an illusion!
Under the Waste Pill Peak, there is really suppressed... or rather, a huge torrent of earth vein spiritual energy that is forcibly locked!
That dragon-shaped shadow, that dark gold chain, that sorrow and anger that has been lingering for thousands of years...
"The ruins of the cat fairy...the core of the earth's veins..."
Lin Mo murmured to himself, looking at the huge black stone with unprecedented solemnity and heat.
Where is this useless peak? This is clearly a sealed treasure mountain!
The people of the Beast Control Sect, or the people who placed this seal a hundred years ago, are really wasting their resources!
He tried to put the cat's paw on the boulder again, carefully mobilizing a weak spiritual power.
This time, he no longer forcibly "combs"
Or feel deeply, but like the gentlest feather blowing across the water.
Inside the boulder, the violent pulse seemed to have calmed down a lot, but the heaviness of being imprisoned was still clear.
He can vaguely "listen"
to a low "whimpering" that seems to come from the depths of the earth
, with unwillingness and desire.
"Now is not the time."
Lin Mo took back his hand and his eyes regained their clarity.
With his current strength, rashly touching this power would be tantamount to seeking death.
The top priority is to accumulate strength, improve yourself, and improve the cat group!
Whether it is to deal with the troubles of Manager Zhao and Wang Mang, or to unlock the seal of this earth vein in the future, stronger capital is needed.
He took one last deep look at the boulder that seemed to be suppressing the fate of the entire Waste Pill Peak, turned around, and although his steps were still a little frivolous, his eyes were extremely firm and he walked towards the mountainside spiritual field.
…
A few days later.
The early morning fog had not completely dissipated yet, Lin Mo descended from Feidan Peak alone and walked towards the General Affairs Hall of the Beast Control Sect.
He needs to receive the meager rations and supplies included in this month's handyman quota - this is the guarantee for the basic survival of himself and the cats.
